reviews.text: I decided to leave a review because the technicians fixed my portable A/C quickly, though they could have communicated a bit better about the part they needed to order. Overall, I was satisfied with the repair but clearer updates would have been appreciated.👍
reviews.author: JEREMY C.

reviews.text: Compared to a previous service I used, the scheduling process with management was more straightforward this time, and Portable A/C Services handled the installation efficiently. While communication could have been quicker, the job itself was done effectively.
reviews.author: MASON U.

reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised when the cost for dismantling my A/C system was exactly what I had been quoted, and the technician took time to explain every step thoroughly.
reviews.author: Dwight J.
